findings.summary: The block-A cost sum for the funding event does not apply addendum section 13 point 2 (Branch full for every plan and cost estimate until W1-18's result)
findings.where: stage1-preregistration-rev4.md section 10.5, row 'Block A, summed' (line 841); req21-w1-record.md item (d) rule 11 (line 196) and Z.5 block A row (line 704)
findings.evidence: Addendum section 13 point 2: 'Until the result exists, plans and cost estimates use Branch full.' Both files write this rule (rev4 section 6.3 line 542; record (e) rule 5 lines 212-213 and the 'Open for the lead' line 230). But the summed block-A estimate is still 'about $49-75 before LN-15e, and about $70-101 with LN-15e'. Its parts: runs about $41; c0 $0.4-1.1; regenerations $3-6; LN-14 $0.7; O-ext share '$4-10 (Branch 128) or $15-26 (Branch full)'. The low end, 41 + 0.4 + 3 + 0.7 + 4 = $49.1, takes the Branch 128 O-ext share. Also, LN-14 (about $0.7) runs only under Branch 128 (rev4 line 554: 'under Branch 128, theta0's 400 PHTest answers ...').
findings.fix: Do the sum again under Branch full and keep the Branch 128 figure only as a stated alternative. Runs $41, c0 $0.4-1.2 (2,400 s, see the next finding), regenerations $3-6, O-ext share $15-26, and no LN-14 give about $59-74 (E). With LN-15e ($15-19 + $5.6-7.1) the sum is about $80-100 (E). Write the result into rev4 section 10.5, record (d) rule 11 and record Z.5. Optionally add 'about $49-75 if W1-18 later picks Branch 128'. Copy the parts from their sources, as the brief requires.
